name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet
prompt: A historically grounded mid-15th-century Ottoman Janissary siege infantryman, rendered as crisp 32x32 pixel art across eight compass-direction rotations, isolated on a transparent background, no environment. Sturdy, battle-hardened build; sun-darkened skin; thick mustache with clean-shaven chin per Janissary custom; white felt börk with a simple brass kaşıklık holder and short plume, an earlier and plainer style than later centuries. Wears a dark green kaftan lined in red, visible at the cuffs and collar, a leather sash, coarse şalvar trousers, sturdy leather boots suited to siege-camp mud. Carries a round wooden shield faced with hide and iron studs on one arm, a curved yatağan at the hip, and either an early hand-cannon or a composite bow slung across the back — the corps' transitional arsenal as firearms first entered Ottoman service under Murad II. Clean, saturated period-appropriate color palette (whites, forest greens, iron greys, browns), bold black outlines, readable silhouette at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
